Mia: Morning async — quick updates
Mia: Yesterday: finished the token-rotation retry logic in api-gateway (PR #2345). Noticed intermittent 503s when KMS rotates keys.
Sam: saw the 503s on prod-canary logs too. Looks like kv-cache miss + header mismatch. :thinking_face:
Jordan: can you paste the failing log snippet? I pushed a small patch to ensure we fallback to old key for 30s.
Mia: here's snippet:
```
2026-03-17T22:11:03Z gw[req]: auth: failed verify - key-not-found k=key-20260317
2026-03-17T22:11:04Z gw[req]: upstream 503 token-rotation
```
Mia: Blocker: need an infra approve for KMS fallback, vendor-signed rotation policy needs review.
Lee: I can take the infra approval ticket today. Also re: rate limits — I started the per-route dynamic bucket POC, but there's an edge where bursts from healthchecks bypass the limiter.
Sam: For healthchecks, we can gate by UA and route name. Quick rule: if UA=redwood-probe -> low priority.
Jordan: I'll add a canary flag to the routing policy so healthcheck route doesn't increment the user bucket.
ci-bot: Build passed for commit 7a9f2c (PR #2345) :white_check_mark:
Mia: Plans today: open infra ticket, pair with Jordan on canary flag, and get review from Sam.
Sam: I'll review PR later today, and run a small canary against staging cluster.
Lee: will create infra ticket and ping security for KMS rollback window. ETA ~2h.
Jordan: ping me when you open the canary so I can wire up the metric alert (latency + 5xx rate).
Mia: thanks all. if anyone hits the 503s, add logs to #incidents and tag me.
Sam: noted. :thumbsup:
Lee: LGTM
Jordan: will do.
